summary.text: Bjorn Olson is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 22A, with a tenure beginning in 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Olson is an Army Reserve captain who has worked as a history teacher and farmer.

paragraphs.text: Bjorn Olson was born in Fairmont, Minnesota.
He earned a B.A. in history and social studies education from Bethel University and an M.A. in American military history from American Military University.
Olson has served in the U.S. Army and U.S. Army Reserve and has reached the rank of captain, and his career experience includes working as a U.S. history teacher and a farmer.
Ballotpedia lists Olson's tenure in the Minnesota House as beginning in 2021, and says he assumed office in District 22A on January 3, 2023.

For 2025 and 2026 he was assigned to the Children and Families Finance and Policy, Legacy Finance, Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy (as co-vice chair) and Transportation Finance and Policy committees.
